content.text: 末尾问题是：同步 memory 并装 testcluster SSH，再连 `dolphinscheduler-2` 验通。开始执行。

input.command: cd ~/.dc-platform/memory && git pull --rebase && ls -la bootstrap/testcluster-ssh/install-on-host.sh ~/.dc-platform/config/git-ssh-bundle.pass 2>&1 | head -20 && head -n 40 bootstrap/testcluster-ssh/install-on-host.sh
input.description: Pull memory repo and inspect install script

input.command: bash ~/.dc-platform/scripts/lookup-rules.sh testcluster-ssh 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls ~/.dc-platform/memory/bootstrap/testcluster-ssh/ 2>/dev/null; which ssh; ping -c 1 -W 2 dolphinscheduler-2 2>&1 | head -5 || true; scutil --nc list 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true

export GIT_SSH_BUNDLE_PASS="$(cat ~/.dc-platform/config/git-ssh-bundle.pass)" && bash ~/.dc-platform/memory/bootstrap/testcluster-ssh/install-on-host.sh && echo "--- install done ---" && grep -A20 -E 'dolphinscheduler-2|testcluster' ~/.ssh/config 2>/dev/null | head -40 && ls -la ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_testcluster ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_testcluster.pub 2>&1
input.description: Install testcluster SSH key and Host alias

content.text:
三步都跑通了：

1. **记忆仓**：`~/.dc-platform/memory` `git pull --rebase` → 已经是最新的  
2. **本机 SSH 安装**：`install-on-host.sh` 成功 → 已写入 `Host dolphinscheduler-2`，私钥 `~/.ssh/id_ed25519_testcluster`  
3. **连通验证**：
   ```text
   hostname → dolphinscheduler-2
   whoami  → bigdata-dev
   ```

可以正常 `ssh dolphinscheduler-2`；切 hadoop 用 `sudo -iu hadoop`。
